description: Git hooks setup guide for Stock Agent development workflow
note: These are Git lifecycle hooks (not Claude Code hooks) - install to .git/hooks/
setup_instructions: 3. Hooks will run automatically on git commit, push, pull, etc.

pre-commit.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo 'Running pre-commit checks...'
python -m tests.test_setup
echo 'Pre-commit checks passed'
pre-commit.purpose: Prevent committing broken or insecure code

pre-push.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo 'Running pre-push validation...'
python -m tests.test_setup
echo 'Pre-push validation passed'
pre-push.purpose: Final validation before sharing code to remote

post-merge.purpose: Ensure merged changes don't break local setup

notes: Git hooks are stored in .git/hooks/ and are not version-controlled
For team-wide hooks, consider using husky (Node.js) or similar frameworks
These examples use python -m tests.test_setup for validation
Adjust scripts to match your preferred validation commands
